comment: ADR 0143's phase register (R12-ARCH-7134). One row per blueprint build phase (GCP v2.1 §26 and §26.1), in order. state is not_entered, entered or exited; a phase may be entered or exited only when its predecessor is exited, and an exited phase names the tests that demonstrate its exit capability. Moving a state is a reviewed commit carrying the run that shows those tests passing. ahead_of_phase lists what the tree already carries ahead of a phase that is not entered, and the switch (a tfvar, an environment variable, or none) that keeps it off in deployment; 'none' says plainly that nothing does. Checked by backend/crates/tests/qip-acceptance/tests/phase_register.rs.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.exit_capability: Every foundation deliverable exists and its exit test passes: projects, IAM/PAM, Terraform modules, NCC/VPC/DNS/firewalls, KMS/CA, audit/SCC and GitHub WIF.

phases.title: Supply chain
phases.exit_capability: Images are built once in a private pool, stored by digest, attested and promoted only by GitOps.

ahead_of_phase.capability: Artifact Registry with immutable tags, Binary Authorization attestation and the reproducibility check in deploy.yml
ahead_of_phase.reason: built and run by the dev deploy before phase 0 exited; a supply chain is needed to deploy anything at all

ahead_of_phase.capability: GitOps control plane (Argo CD, Kargo, Config Connector, ADR 0036)
ahead_of_phase.reason: declared ahead of phase; dev turns it on

ahead_of_phase.capability: Cloud Build private pool
ahead_of_phase.reason: declared, off

ahead_of_phase.capability: qip-fabricd broker binary and the event-fabric protocol
ahead_of_phase.reason: built and tested in-process; no broker is deployed

ahead_of_phase.capability: Spanner
